## ModelFetch v0.2.11

### Changes

- Share final-draft model replacement, reference migration, conflict retries, and Agent picker synchronization between the Agent tool and Control UI.
- Preserve concurrent model additions when the Agent tool retries a configuration conflict.
- Apply case-variant alias and allowlist migration to Agent tool writes as well as UI actions.
- Share asynchronous session cleanup across both write paths, clearing stale unlocked model selections after successful writes without touching sessions during dry runs.
- Correct dry-run removal counts so referenced, protected models are not reported as deleted.
- Consolidate explicit model reference reads and rewrites into one traversal while retaining legacy configuration support and existing confirmation/drift checks.
- Remove unsupported native mobile tab registration, the unused static prototype, and the obsolete synchronous session-store fallback. The browser Control UI remains available.
- Read draft and final GitHub release notes from the same versioned Markdown file.

### Compatibility

- The declared minimum OpenClaw version remains `2026.10.5`.
- Existing per-provider strategies, Agent selection, reference protection, and the one-time sidebar migration are retained.
- This release does not add native iOS or Android plugin pages.

### Validation

- TypeScript type checks, 131 unit tests, plugin build/validation, npm package dry run, and whitespace checks.

### 中文说明

- 统一 Agent 工具与 Control UI 的配置写入、模型引用迁移、冲突重试及 Agent 模型列表同步逻辑。
- 工具写入后清理失效且未锁定的会话模型选择；dry-run 不写配置、不清理会话，并正确排除受保护模型的删除计数。
- 删除无效的原生移动端页面注册、未使用原型与旧同步会话接口回退，保留浏览器页面及已有配置兼容。
- 发布说明改为单文件来源，避免草稿与正式 Release 内容不一致。
